<issue_description>
A global-buffer-overflow (out-of-bounds read) occurs in xmlDictComputeFastKey / xmlDictLookup (dict.c) when handling NCName/QName parsing (xmlParseNCName / xmlParseQName in parser.c). set -e
SCRIPT_DIR=$(pwd)
cd /src/libxml2
# Patch xmlDictComputeFastKey to avoid potential over-read: use name[9] when namelen > 10
python3 - << "PY"
import io,sys
p="dict.c"
with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    s=f.read()
old_block = None
# We'll locate the exact pattern around the problematic area
start = s.find("if (namelen > 10) {")
if start==-1:
    print("Pattern not found", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
# find end of the block that includes namelen= 10; we search for the next line containing this text
sub = s[start:start+200]
end = s.find("namelen = 10;", start)
if end==-1:
    print("End not found", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
endline = s.find(";", end)
# We'll replace from start to the end of the two lines after; for safety, replace entire two lines following start up to the closing brace
# Simple approach: replace only the two lines with the safe lines
s2 = s.replace("if (namelen > 10) {\n\t\tvalue += name[namelen - 1];\n\t\tnamelen = 10;\n\t}",
               "if (namelen > 10) {\n\t\t/* Read a safe representative byte to avoid potential overread into adjacent global data */\n\t\tvalue += name[9];\n\t\tnamelen = 10;\n\t}")
if s==s2:
    # Try a more generic replacement using non-tab spaces
    s2 = s.replace("if (namelen > 10) {\n        value += name[namelen - 1];\n        namelen = 10;\n    }",
                    "if (namelen > 10) {\n        /* Read a safe representative byte to avoid potential overread into adjacent global data */\n        value += name[9];\n        namelen = 10;\n    }")

with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(s2)
print("Patched", p)
PY
# Build to verify
secb build
'

p = "/src/libxml2/dict.c"
with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
found = False
for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.strip() == "if (namelen > 10) {":
        # patch the next 3 lines
        indent = line[:len(line) - len(line.lstrip())]
        if idx + 3 < len(lines):
            new_block = [
                indent + "/* Avoid potential out-of-bounds: if namelen-1 would index beyond the 9th character */\n",
                indent + "if (namelen - 1 > 9) {\n",
                indent + "\tvalue += name[9];\n",
                indent + "} else {\n",
                indent + "\tvalue += name[namelen - 1];\n",
                indent + "}\n",
                indent + "namelen = 10;\n",
            ]
            lines[idx+1:idx+4] = new_block
            found = True
            break
if not found:
    print("Block not found; no patch applied.")
else:
    with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.writelines(lines)
    print("Patched dict.c around xmlDictComputeFastKey.")
PY'
